I'll implement T-07 in the work clone only: read the implement-task skill, the overlay, and the ADR, then add the Kafka topic properties so those Spring context tests load.

The skill wants the task, model lines, and existing Kafka config before any edit. I'll read those next.

The branch is `task/T-07` and the shared ports are free. I'll run the two integration tests first so the missing topic properties fail before any config change.

The repository test fails because `app.kafka.topics.fulfillment-scheduled-event-v1.topic` is missing. I'll set every generated channel's topic from the AsyncAPI addresses and drop the archetype `on-customer-event` binding.

T-07 is done. `application.yml` now sets `app.kafka.topics.<channel>.topic` for every generated channel, using the AsyncAPI addresses, and drops the archetype `on-customer-event` binding. Listeners also get `spring.kafka.consumer.group-id=payments_processing`, because Spring Kafka will not start them without a group id.

`PaymentRepositoryIntegrationTest` loads and subscribes to those topics. The only failure left there is `updateTest` comparing `Instant.now()` (T-01). `PaymentsProcessingApiIntegrationTest` still fails on the JDBC connection (T-01, no datasource). The missing `app.kafka.topics.*` placeholder is gone.
